description.en: Finish any vocabulary test with at least 5 questions.
description.zh: 完成任一場至少 5 題的單字測驗。

description.en: Get every word right in a fill-in-the-blank test on Spelling Bee Grade 1 part 1, 3 times, with at least 20 questions.
description.zh: 在「Spelling Bee 一年級 第一部分」的填空測驗中全部答對 3 次，每次至少 20 題。

description.en: Finish 10 tests that use only Spelling Bee lists, each with at least 10 questions.
description.zh: 完成 10 場只使用 Spelling Bee 單字表的測驗，每場至少 10 題。

description.en: Win every round of a hangman game with at least 10 words.
description.zh: 在至少 10 題的猜單字遊戲中全部猜對。
